content:
Boooooo! What spooooky times we now live in, with AI rapidly advancing in capabilities and solving more and more major open math problems!

So it seems like a perfect occasion to share yet another podcast. I know I’ve been dropping them like every day, but this is a special one, with Brian Greene for his World Science Festival, recorded in-person when I visited Columbia University a week ago. Note that we don’t talk about OpenAI’s refutation of the Exponential Time Hypothesis because the announcement of that was still two days in the future!

Bonus Addition From Just This Morning (Nov. 3): Another podcast, about quantum computing, foundations of quantum mechanics, AI, consciousness, and I forget what else … this one with writer Robert Wright, whose book The Moral Animal made a huge impression on me back when I was 13 years old!
